status: reviewed by the maintainer on 4 November 2026
description: Retrieval benchmark for the Employees' Compensation Act 2010 (as enacted). Each query names the one section that best answers it; Recall@10 is measured against this release's own retrieval documents. Queries mix everyday and legal wording and were checked against the approved text on 4 November 2026.

queries.query: What is the Employees' Compensation Act for?
Does the Employees' Compensation Act cover people working in private companies?
queries.note: s.2(1) all employers and employees in public and private sectors.

queries.query: Are soldiers covered by employees' compensation?
queries.note: s.3 armed forces excluded except civilian staff.

queries.query: I got injured at work, how many days do I have to tell my employer?
How soon must my employer report my work accident to NSITF?
What is the deadline to apply for workmen's compensation after an accident?
queries.note: s.6(2)-(3) one year, up to 3 years in special circumstances.

queries.query: I had an accident on my way to work, can I get compensation?
queries.note: s.7(2) accidents between work and residence.

queries.query: Can I claim compensation for stress caused by my job?
I got sick from chemicals at my workplace, can I be compensated?
My hearing got damaged by noise at the factory, what can I claim?
I was injured while working outside the office on official duty
queries.note: s.11 injuries outside the normal workplace.

queries.query: Can I sue my employer in court after a workplace injury instead of claiming compensation?
queries.note: s.12(1) Act in lieu of right of action.

queries.query: My employer made me sign a paper giving up my right to compensation, is it valid?
Can my employer deduct money from my salary for the compensation fund?
Can a creditor seize my injury compensation payment?
Will NSITF help an injured worker get retrained to go back to work?
How much will my family get if I die from a work accident?
What happens if a worker dies in a terrorist attack or riot while on duty?
queries.note: s.18 enemy warlike action; s.73 defines it.

queries.query: How much is paid for permanent total disability from a work injury?
How is compensation calculated if I lose a finger at work?
queries.note: s.22 permanent partial disability with Second Schedule.

queries.query: Until what age are disability payments made?
queries.note: s.23 until 55, or two years after the injury if older.

queries.query: Will the Board pay my hospital bills after a workplace injury?
queries.note: s.26 health care and disability support.

queries.query: What must a doctor do when treating an injured worker?
queries.note: s.27 duty of accredited medical practitioner.

queries.query: Does compensation affect my pension under the Pension Reform Act?
How much must an employer pay into the Employees' Compensation Fund every month?
queries.note: s.33(1) 1.0 per cent of monthly payroll.

queries.query: What is the penalty for an employer who does not pay the NSITF assessment?
Can NSITF officers enter a workplace without a warrant?
queries.note: s.54(a) enter with or without warrant.

queries.query: How do I appeal if I disagree with the Board's decision on my claim?
queries.note: s.55 review within 180 days, then National Industrial Court.

queries.query: Who manages the Employees' Compensation Fund?
What is the punishment for giving false information to NSITF?
I cannot read or write, how do I give notice of my injury?
queries.note: s.69 Board may waive written notice.

queries.query: Did the Employees' Compensation Act replace the Workmen's Compensation Act?
Who counts as a dependant for employees' compensation?
